dedupe_keys.name: etcs rollout on infrabel rail network

description: ETCS rollout on Infrabel rail network is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Infrabel. Schematic representation with geolocation of Infrabel's network currently equipped with ETCS or equivalent. The ETCS (European Train Control System) is an automatic European safety system that greatly reduces the risk of a train driving through a red signal. Speeding, cause of many train accidents, also becomes virtually impossible. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are ETCS, Geolocalisatie, Sporen, Lijnen. The portal shows 1,234 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-07-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open licentie CC0 - Universeel (https://infrabel.opendatasoft.com/pages/license/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
